availability.limitation: EIDC archives do not provide historical data-availability timestamps; the pipeline records null and never substitutes retrieval time.
availability.post_2018_finding: Catalogue search found lower-frequency Windermere South Basin surface-monitoring records for 2019-2025, but no additional automatic-buoy block. These are not substituted.
